title: depends build fails due to OpenBSD touch incompatibility with -h option
summary: The depends build breaks on OpenBSD because its native touch doesn't support -h. Make the OpenBSD builder work without it.

title: wallet: Migration fails for legacy wallet with no keys watching an address
summary: Migrating a legacy wallet that has no keys but watches an address fails. A reproducing functional test is in the issue; find and fix the migration path.

title: qa: Intermittent failure in `p2p_eviction.py`
summary: p2p_eviction.py fails intermittently in CI. Reproduce the flake from the logs and make the test deterministic.

title: bdk_esplora: document that prevout values inserted during sync are unverified server-reported data
summary: bdk_esplora stores prevout values straight from the server during sync. Document that these are unverified server-reported data and what that means for fee calculations.

title: feat(chain): derive Copy and implement AddAssign, Sub, SubAssign, Sum for Balance
summary: Derive Copy for bdk_chain::Balance and add AddAssign, Sub, SubAssign and Sum so balances can be combined ergonomically. Small, well-scoped Rust change.

title: filter_iter example fails to compile on Windows because it depends on bdk_testenv
summary: The filter_iter example doesn't compile on Windows because it depends on bdk_testenv. Restructure the dependency so new developers can run the example.

title: hashes has lint warnings on master
summary: The hashes crate produces lint warnings on master (e.g. deprecated max_value). Clean them up so the build is warning-free.

title: p2p: BIP434 FeatureId rejects non-ASCII identifiers
summary: BIP434 FeatureId rejects non-ASCII identifiers, but the BIP only recommends ASCII and Bitcoin Core accepts them. Align the validation with the spec.

title: [feature]: allow updating a channel's memo
summary: A channel memo can only be set when opening. Add an RPC (and lncli command) to update the memo on existing pending or open channels.

title: chainfee: bitcoind 32.0 estimatesmartfee can omit `feerate`, silently dropping lnd to its static fallback fee rate
summary: Bitcoin Core 32's estimatesmartfee can omit the feerate field, and lnd silently treats that as zero and falls back to a static fee. Detect and handle the missing field.

title: plugins/recover: missing comma in nodes_for_gossip concatenates two bootstrap addresses into invalid address
summary: A missing comma in plugins/recover.c joins two bootstrap node addresses into one invalid string. A one-line fix plus a quick test - a great first CLN PR.

title: common/json_parse: json_to_bitcoin_amount fails to detect overflow and accepts negative/empty inputs
summary: json_to_bitcoin_amount has a tautological overflow check and accepts negative or empty inputs. Fix the parsing and add tests for the edge cases.

title: v26.06.9 not compiling on FreeBSD 15.1 (ccan/ccan/asort/asort.h with a solution)
summary: v26.06.9 fails to compile on FreeBSD 15.1 due to a qsort_r clash in ccan's asort.h. The issue includes a proposed solution to turn into a PR.

title: Let each tab work on its own node instead of sharing the session's selected node
summary: The selected node is per browser session, so two tabs can't manage different nodes. Make node selection per tab.

title: [BUG] Pending sweep fails fiat invoices after the Lightning expiry (1 h) without asking the provider; a later Stripe payment is never credited
summary: Fiat invoices (Stripe, PayPal, etc.) are expired after the 1h Lightning expiry without checking the provider, so later payments are never credited. Check with the provider before failing them.

title: [BUG] Failed payment shows as sent in NWC connector
summary: Payments that failed (no preimage) show as sent in the extension's NWC connector, while Alby Hub shows them as failed. Fix the status mapping.

title: Custom node images fail to start unless the data dir is set in the command
summary: Custom node images that run as root fail to start because the default commands don't pass a data dir. Pass the data dir flag explicitly so custom images work.

title: Feature Request: Explain host port vs. container port when connecting to nodes
summary: Users new to Docker confuse host and container ports when connecting to nodes. Add clear UI guidance explaining which port to use from where.

title: Bug: .deb package is missing the libasound2 dependency
summary: The .deb package doesn't declare libasound2, so Polar fails to start on minimal Ubuntu. Add the missing package dependency.

title: Failure to reject `open_channel` where funder cannot pay commitment fee
summary: BOLT 2 requires rejecting open_channel when the funder can't pay the initial commitment fee, and eclair doesn't. Add the check and a test.

title: ellswift: constant-time tests don't cover `auxrnd32` in `secp256k1_ellswift_create`
summary: The constant-time tests don't cover auxrnd32 in secp256k1_ellswift_create, and the code isn't constant time in it. Extend the ctime tests and fix the gap.

title: Add shell completions command to payjoin-cli
summary: Add a completions subcommand to payjoin-cli that generates shell completions, following the approach already used in bdk-cli.

title: Make Bindings README § Stability static
summary: The Stability section of the bindings README needs a version bump every release. Rewrite it so it's static.

title: DRY up payjoin-mailroom tests
summary: payjoin-mailroom tests repeat a lot of setup code. Refactor the shared code into helpers used across the existing tests.

title: core: Amount::from_str panics on values above 21M BTC instead of returning an error
summary: Amount::from_str panics on values above 21M BTC instead of returning an error. Return a parse error and add a test.

title: core: SafeUrl::join_path corrupts URL credentials and drops query/fragment
summary: SafeUrl::join_path re-parses a stringified URL, which corrupts credentials and drops the query and fragment. Reimplement it on the URL type directly.

title: `nominal_hash_rate` is accepting NaN and others
summary: nominal_hash_rate in OpenChannel and UpdateChannel accepts NaN and other nonsensical floats. Reject invalid values and add tests.

title: `channels_sv2`: document that version-rolling policy is per job and that standard channels always roll (client `version_rolling` is a capability; the group-job flag is dropped for standard channels by design)
summary: Document in channels_sv2's rustdocs that version rolling is a per-job policy and that standard channels always roll, so embedders know how the flags behave.

title: Add stateful fuzz target for buffer_sv2
summary: buffer_sv2 has no fuzz coverage. Build a structure-aware fuzz target driven by sequences of BufferPool operations.

title: Add a validation check for the training datasets
summary: Add a small script that validates the exported training datasets, so empty or outdated exports (like the Pidgin/Yoruba bug) get caught.

title: Add English entries for Exchange, Payment Channel, Phishing, CPFP and Smart Contract
summary: Write plain-English glossary entries for Exchange, Payment Channel, Phishing, CPFP and Smart Contract - terms already linked from other entries.

title: Fix dataset export for Pidgin and Yoruba (currently exports 0 examples)
summary: npm run export:dataset outputs 0 examples for Pidgin and Yoruba despite 81 entries. Find out why and fix the export.
